Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Maninder S. Bhatti
 On The 9 th Of May, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 20801 of 2025
 Pradeep Varman
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri R.S. Patel - Advocate for the applicant.
 Ms. Vineeta Sharma - Panel Lawyer for the State.
 Shri Dharmendra Patel - Advocate for objector.

Order 
This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.178/2024 dated 29/02/2024 registered at Police Station Gotegaon, District Narsinghpur for the offences punishable under Sections 366A, 376(3), 376(2)(n), 376(2)(f) of IPC and Section 5(j)(ii)/6, 5(n)/6 of POCSO Act.

2. The counsel for the applicant contends that the present applicant and the prosecutrix have entered into wedlock and blessed with a child, therefore he deserves to be enlarged on bail as he is in custody since 26/12/2024.
3. Per contra, counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that offence has been committed with the minor, therefore, no case for bail is made out to the applicant.

4. Counsel for the objector expressed no objection as regards grant of NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:21861 2 MCRC-20801-2025 bail to the applicant.
5. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.

6 . Considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the present applicant and the prosecutrix have entered Pradeep Varman vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16844266/
1 into wedlock and blessed with a child, and the applicant is in custody since 26/12/2024, thus, this Court deems it proper to release the applicant on bail.

sentences.text: Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.

8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (MANINDER S. BHATTI) JUDGE Astha Pradeep Varman vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16844266/
